surfaces.coverage: Convex light-curve reconstruction with approximate thermal size: 115.49 km (catalog ±1.74 km; additional shape and thermal-model uncertainty). Thermal size is used as a volume-scale approximation. An alternative pole remains possible. The grid marks unavailable imagery. The physical size is approximately calibrated by assigning the AKARI thermal effective diameter to the mesh volume-equivalent diameter. Neither source mesh nor spin is modified. Convex inversion supplies only broad outline; no resolved craters, concavities, reflectance or regolith texture can be inferred. Select ATLAS convex model 4643 (197,9), retaining 4644 (22,15). The 2020 table gives two poles and 22.1157 h; the 2021 ASAS-SN table gives (32,37)/(202,24) and 22.116 h. These are independent broad-family checks, not release identity or a uniquely resolved pole.

surfaceSampling.previewPolicy: Radial rays with more than one distinct source intersection are withheld; the triangle atlas samples the source surface in 3D.

transfer.method: Closest full-source triangle point in 3D; source barycentric radius and normal. No radial branch selection.
